description: January 28 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 28 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the first decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: The January 28 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Another Aquarian self-starter appears on January 28, where 28 reduces to 1. The Sun is about eight degrees into the fixed air sign, still in its first decan, so Uranus colours both the sign and the subdivision. Expect, in traditional terms, a pioneer of unconventional methods who is comfortable standing slightly apart from the crowd.

Astronomically, January 28 puts the Sun near 8° Aquarius in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Uranus. Uranus, the modern ruler of Aquarius, also governs its opening decan, from about January 21 to January 29. This is traditionally the most independent and inventive part of the sign. Late-January birthdays are commonly linked with original thinkers, interested in the future, technology, social change and the freedom to be exactly themselves. Friendship tends to matter as much as romance, sometimes more. Doubled Uranus can bring a contrarian streak and an emotional detachment that others misread as coldness. Their gift is seeing possibilities ahead of the crowd and inviting others along without pressure.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for January 28
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a January 28 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous January 28 birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 28 is the 28th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Pisces, is usually complete within 22 days, by February 19.

Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 28 in 31 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it. Among the best-known people with a January 28 birthday are Nicolas Sarkozy (1955), Jackson Pollock (1912) and Gianluigi Buffon (1978).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 28?
faq.answer: January 28 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 28 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 28?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, January 28 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 31 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 28?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on January 28 include Nicolas Sarkozy (1955), Jackson Pollock (1912) and Gianluigi Buffon (1978). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
